title: Mediterranean Bean Skewers
description: A colorful and flavorful dish featuring Mediterranean flavors with crispy vegetables and tender beans, all perfectly grilled on skewers.

ingredients.name: beans
ingredients.notes: any type of bean works well

ingredients.name: vibrant bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color bell pepper works well

ingredients.name: light cherry tomatoes
ingredients.notes: halved or quartered for easier grilling

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: Soak skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Cut the bell peppers and cherry tomatoes in half.
Thread the beans, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, and fresh basil leaves onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh basil leaves.
